comment: The last time I walked my booner at the edge of the Outback, honey-coated lizards tossed little sugary rockets into the air… Did anyone else see those? Of course the Council's anti-Pong scheme was created so the gum candy can jump right onto them so it never melts a thing – except right down the lane. We're going all ‘Gummy Karmatic Vortex’. Time’s up for the *Minnie*!

My grandmother's wombas are starting a strike. The only ones eating it so can’t call a ‘c’ – a Pong. In reality this project could unlock a portal across Aussie that turns anyone into a sugar‑ball‐hologram to battle 'Ping Pong' invulnerability in space. Who cares about pennies!
